response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced full-stack and systems engineer with genuine GIS/geospatial project experience (GISCollective) and some low-level C/C++ background, but his recent professional work is overwhelmingly focused on TypeScript/Node.js web development rather than modern C++ or Rust, and there is no evidence of distributed-systems routing infrastructure, tiling pipelines, or navigation guidance QA work required for this role.
strengths: Genuine geospatial/GIS domain exposure through the GISCollective project
Broad, adaptable technical background across many languages and systems, showing willingness to learn
Strong track record of ownership, from founding projects to leading technical initiatives and workshops
concerns: C++ experience is largely from 2014-2015 (NI LabWindows) and not recent or central to his current stack
No listed experience with Rust, routing algorithms, or navigation/traffic data pipelines
Career has trended toward web/product engineering (TypeScript, Node.js) rather than systems-level distributed infrastructure work

key_factors.factor: Lack of recent/deep C++ or Rust expertise
No routing/navigation pipeline or distributed systems experience
